title: Race Car Test 2
briefing:
Klaus: Verify the repaired car over THREE LAPS within 220 seconds. Three repeated four-gate pad circuits enforce all three laps, then a separate finish. Shared gates wait their turn. The source leaves cold, wet Weissach for Monaco: normal warm tyres are retained; cold weather and the source no-damage rule are not simulated. No GT1 config exists.
The pad stands in for Monte Carlo Circuit 2; its Boxster stands in for the 1998 Porsche 911 GT1 race version. Police, traffic, vehicle damage and opponents are not simulated.
